The 21 samples demonstrate bidirectional transformation between data representations. Nine samples require students to present raw numerical data as pictographs (data to pictograph direction). Twelve samples require students to read pictographs and extract or transform them into numeric table entries (pictograph to data direction). This bidirectionality fulfills the vice_versa requirement by showing both conversion pathways explicitly and repeatedly across the sample set.
